about: Prose keeps its shape. The riddle's verse continues in lower case after each `\n` and reads so; the ring of letters is a `{verbatim}` block, its spaces and indentation kept past the indentation of its own tag's line; the last paragraph, written in lower case, reads in lower case. The description opens with `{bucket}`, a name the engine renders, and only that is capitalised.

expect.words: A bucket hangs over the well, and letters ring its rim.

Cut into the stone:
what is tall as a house,
round as a cup,
and all the king's horses can't draw it up?
